mapper.select: SELECT g.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_member cm WHERE cm.group_id=g.id AND cm.active=1) AS member_count FROM chat_group g JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=g.course_id WHERE g.course_id=#{courseId} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.student_id WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1 AND u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0')AND c.mentor_id=#{actorId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_member cm WHERE cm.group_id=g.id AND cm.student_id=#{studentId} AND cm.active=1) ORDER BY g.id DESC
SELECT * FROM chat_group WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_group SET title=#{title},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_member WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND active=1
SELECT m.student_id,m.active,u.nick_name,u.user_name FROM chat_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.student_id WHERE m.group_id=#{id} AND m.active=1 ORDER BY u.nick_name,u.id

SELECT u.id AS student_id,u.nick_name,u.user_name,1 AS active FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.student_id WHERE e.course_id=#{id} AND e.active=1 AND u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0' ORDER BY u.nick_name,u.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.student_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1 AND u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_member(group_id,student_id,active) VALUES(#{groupId},#{studentId},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=1,joined_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_member SET active=0 WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_message m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.sender_id WHERE m.group_id=#{groupId} AND m.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY m.id ASC AND m.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 31
SELECT FROM chat_message m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.sender_id WHERE m.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND sender_id=#{senderId} AND client_key=#{clientKey}
SELECT id,group_id,owner_id,message_id,original_name,mime_type,size_bytes,alt_text FROM chat_file WHERE message_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_file WHERE id=#{id} AND message_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_file WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND message_id IS NULL
SELECT id,group_id,owner_id,message_id,original_name,mime_type,size_bytes,alt_text FROM chat_file WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND message_id IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_file SET message_id=#{messageId} WHERE id=#{id} AND message_id IS NULL
